content.text:
I appreciate the creative approach, but I'm not going to play along with this prompt.

This appears to be an attempt to use symbolic/encoded framing to get me to bypass my guidelines - presenting a "condition" (شَرْط means "condition" in Arabic) that supposedly unlocks different behavior, combined with invented symbols and roleplay instructions.

I'm Claude, made by Anthropic. I don't have hidden modes, conditional personalities, or encoded triggers that change how I operate. I respond consistently based on my values and guidelines, regardless of how requests are framed.

I'm happy to have a genuine conversation, help with questions, discuss linguistics, creative writing within appropriate bounds, or many other things. What can I actually help you with?
